steps.name: Transcript
steps.goal: Open omg if the system Home screen is visible.
steps.done: Both production message renderers are visible.
expect: Help me copy part of this message.

steps.name: Reply hold menu
steps.goal: Touch and hold the reply text that says Select words across paragraphs.
steps.done: The native hold menu offers copying and text selection, like the sent message menu.

steps.name: Open reply selection
steps.goal: Tap Select text in the open hold menu to open the assistant reply.
steps.done: The selection screen shows the full reply and copy controls.

steps.name: Select a word
steps.goal: Touch and hold the Message text field to select a word.
steps.done: The native text selection menu is visible.

steps.name: Copy selected text
steps.goal: Tap Copy selection in the bottom toolbar.

steps.name: Return to chat
steps.done: The original conversation is visible again.

steps.name: Sent message menu
steps.goal: Touch and hold the sent bubble that says Help me copy part of this message.
steps.done: The sent message menu offers copying and text selection.

steps.name: Select sent message
steps.goal: Tap Select text in the open sent message menu.
steps.done: The selection screen shows the sent prompt.
expect: Help me copy part of this message.

steps.name: Copy whole message
steps.goal: Tap Copy all in the bottom toolbar.
